newsitem.title: FRANCE: Extra Thai freighter boosts demand.
newsitem.headline: Extra Thai freighter boosts demand.

text.p: PARIS, Oct 16 Reuter - Thai Airways said a surge in demand had followed the introduction of an additional freighter between Paris and Bangkok at the beginning of the month.

"The airline had a spare freighter aircraft on its hands and had to deploy it somewhere on a temporary basis and the Paris-Bangkok route was chosen. As things turned out, we've been more than glad to have extra capacity as the past fortnight has seen the market go from strength to strength," a CDG-based Thai cargo official told Reuters.
While Bangkok remained an important destination for shipments, there had also been buoyant demand from Japan and Korea in recent weeks, the official said.
"In some ways, we regret not applying autumn rates increases but the situation really took us by surprise and the opportunity has passed," he stated.
As well as transporting freight in the bellyhold of a daily passenger service, Thai has a code-sharing agreement with Air France on two freighter flights between Paris and Bangkok.

However, the extra frequency, which will operate until November 30, was being operated independently of the French carrier, the official said. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
